title: seeBias: A Comprehensive Tool for Assessing and Visualizing AI Fairness
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical assessment of fairness in AI prediction models (such as risk scores and logistic regression) using metrics like TPR, FPR, and calibration. While fairness is an ethical principle, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral frameworks, or philosophical ethical systems themselves; it is a software toolkit paper for bias detection in tabular prediction models.
